Sam T.: Heads up — canary job for seqlen=64 on A100 nodes spiking p95 token latency this morning. Looks like kernel picker flipped to an FP8 fastpath after the driver update.
Jessie L.: repro or logs?
Sam T.: minimal repro below, happened on node-3 & node-7. perf profile shows memcpy/KV churn during generation: 
```
[perf] model=gptx-6b
seq=64 batch=8
kernel_path=fp8_fastpath
p95_token_ms=18.4  (baseline ~6.2)
kv_evictions_per_min=220
memcpy_time_ms=45
```
Anita R.: FP8 shouldn't be picked on these cards. What did device probe return?
Sam T.: ran probe locally on node-3, output: 
```
probe-bot: device=0, pci=0000:3b:00.0
sm=80, tensor_cores=1, bf16=1, fp8=0
driver=537.13
capflags=SM=80;TC=1;BF16=1;FP8=0;quirks=none
```
Harpreet K.: odd — kernel selector has a recent heuristic: if (tensor_cores && driver>=537) treat as fp8-capable for fastpath perf. Could be our heuristic over-eager.
Jessie L.: we added that to win perf on some farms, but I thought we gated it by a runtime probe too. Maybe the probe is returning intermittent values after the driver hotpatch.
Anita R.: plausible race: cudaGetAttribute for FP8 capability can return true briefly during driver state transitions. If kernel picker samples that once, it may switch path mid-session. That explains KV layout mismatch and the eviction churn.
Sam T.: additional evidence: traces show kernel_pick changed between tokens 4 and 8 for same request. That correlates with huge memcpy and a spike in GPU stalls.
Harpreet K.: proposed mitigations: 1) make device capability sticky for the node for the duration of the runtime process (no mid-stream flips), 2) add hysteresis to probe results (require N consecutive positive probes), 3) sequence-length gating (don't enable FP8 fastpath for short seqs where KV layout changes are costlier).
Jessie L.: agree. I'd add telemetry: annotate traces with 'kernel_pick_reason' and 'cap_probe_samples' so we can see what triggered flips in canary. Also emit a metric when kernel path differs from the boot sticky value.
Anita R.: micro suggestion: hysteresis=3 by default, sticky per-process until restart, seqlen_threshold=128 (only allow fp8_fastpath when seqlen>=128 or when session is stable for >10s). Also avoid switching for active sessions — only allow new sessions to pick new path.
Sam T.: sounds good. I'll run a quick AB to verify. Can we also add a sanity check in kernel loader to assert KV layout compatibility before switching? If mismatch, log and fall back.
Harpreet K.: yes — I'll draft a small patch: add sticky_capflags in process-state, probe window buffer, gating logic that checks seqlen, and a lightweight layout_compat() validation that compares kv_layout_id. I'll also instrument perf counters to count evictions caused by layout swaps. Opening PR now.
Harpreet K.: https://phab/rD12345 (WIP) — patch includes unit tests and a debug flag to force-cap overrides for repro.
Sam T.: perfect. If PR lands, canary schedule?
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for 1725010200 — image will include Harpreet's PR if merged. :rocket:
Jessie L.: follow-ups: @Harpreet raise PR and add telemetry tags, @Sam run canary & attach perf dump, @Anita validate kv layout compat and create a short test for mid-session switch. I'll monitor the canary channel. :thumbsup:
probe-bot: note: added a low-overhead probe command: `device_probe --sample 3 --sticky` to emulate the new logic locally.
Sam T.: running device_probe now on node-7 with --sample 3, will paste results after canary.
Anita R.: thanks — if this fixes p95 for seq64 we can relax seqlen_threshold later. For now err on the side of conservative picks.
Jessie L.: one last thing — record the driver+cuda combinations that caused the flake in our hardware matrix so on upgrade we can run targeted smoke tests.
Sam T.: will add notes to the upgrade checklist.
